dynamic_lines.creation: append one visible path input; append its index to the display list
dynamic_lines.collection_order: base path first, then dynamic inputs in input-array order; each path contributes line indices from zero upward

distribution_and_sampling.uniform: for amount == 1 use ratio 0.5; otherwise ratio = sample_index / (amount - (loop ? 0 : 1))
distribution_and_sampling.random: call random_set_seed(seed) once before the sample loop; each sample ratio uses the source builtin random(1)
distribution_and_sampling.random_observation: source establishes the seed call and builtin invocation only; exact sequence, endpoint inclusion, and cross-runtime equivalence are not specified here
distribution_and_sampling.range: lerp(range[0], range[1], ratio); reversed endpoints are not reordered
distribution_and_sampling.loop_and_offset: only when loop is true, ratio becomes frac(frac(ratio + offset) + 1); offset is added after range mapping
distribution_and_sampling.source_path_sampling: for every collected line, call that path's getPointRatio(clamp(ratio, 0, 0.999), line_index); copy x, y, and weight into the anchor
distribution_and_sampling.shared_point_output: one _p object is reused across input lines and amount iterations; distance sampling resets x and y, but an invalid anchor index returns before setting weight, so weight can carry from an earlier sample
distribution_and_sampling.global_builtin_state: source resets global builtin state even for Uniform; native captures do not publish that outgoing global state, so inter-node builtin RNG parity remains unverified

smooth_path.handles: for each interior anchor, direction runs from the previous anchor to the next; the previous-side handle is half the previous leg length behind the anchor and the next-side handle is half the next leg length ahead; first and last segment handles are set to their respective endpoint anchors
smooth_path.single_segment_control_quirk: when there is one segment, first-start and last-end initialization both target _cnt[0]; the second assignment overwrites all four coordinates with the final anchor
smooth_path.weight: interpolated linearly between segment endpoint weights using the segment parameter
smooth_path.length_approximation: sum cubic-Bezier distances at k = 0, 1/32, ..., 31/32; the loop condition is k < 1, so it does not add a separate k = 1 sample
smooth_path.overlay: draw each anchor's smoothed segment at j = 0, 1/32, ..., 1

distance_and_ratios.ratio: clamp ratio to [0, 1], multiply by that anchor set's computed length, then use distance sampling
distance_and_ratios.segment_search: choose the first cumulative length strictly greater than distance; equality advances to the next segment
distance_and_ratios.interpolation: derive local parameter from distance within that segment; use linear x/y when not smooth and cubic-Bezier x/y when smooth; interpolate weight linearly
distance_and_ratios.outside_end: if no cumulative entry is strictly greater, return anchor at index equal to the cumulative-length count
distance_and_ratios.segment_count: getSegmentCount(i) returns the safe length of anchors[i], which is the number of collected path lines, not the number of intervals
distance_and_ratios.invalid_anchor_index: distance sampling returns x=0 and y=0 in the output object

state_observations.cached_pos: cleared on update and written by distance sampling, but never read by this source; it is write-only cached state
state_observations.boundary: initialized to an empty array and exposed by getBoundary, but never assigned by update
state_observations.length_total: initialized to an empty array and not assigned by update

undefined_inputs.policy: refuse or report unsupported rather than infer behavior
defined_source_cases: an invalid base path causes update to return early
an invalid dynamic path is skipped
an unrecognized distribution selector uses ratio zero before range mapping
undefined_or_unguarded: missing or malformed seed, range endpoints, amount, or path getter results
amount values that are not valid nonnegative array lengths
zero collected path lines: smooth setup indexes control entries without a guard
one collected path line: smooth setup writes control index -1 without a guard
failed path sampling or unavailable point weights
undefined_inputs.early_return_state: on invalid base path, source has already updated curr_smooth; it retains anchors, controls, lengths, cumulative lengths, boundary, and length_total, while getLineCount still reads the current Amount input. Native may sample retained state within bounds when every required anchor, cumulative length, and smooth control entry exists and is compatible; refuse only missing or incompatible required entries

verification: source-derived policy record only; no parity or verification result claimed

source_boolean_conversion.rule: numeric input is true only when greater than 0.5
